create_target_inbody: create an InBodyTarget instance with kind set to inbody for in-body output
create_target_zip: create a ZipTarget instance with kind set to zip for zip archive output
create_target_s3: create an S3Target instance with kind set to s3 and S3 coordinates for S3 upload output
create_target_put: create a PutTarget instance with kind set to put and a URL for PUT-based output
build_target_union: build a discriminated Target union from InBodyTarget, ZipTarget, S3Target, or PutTarget variants
